files.why: top-level navigation: key locations, important tools, response shaping
warehouse schema; cross-cutting reference for SQL conventions across BPs

/bin/checkout tool surface; a new verb can enable a checkout workflow even without a docs/schema change. affects_units: narrowly scoped to the checkout BP — drift should refresh that unit per-unit, while still surfacing in world-drift attention
/bin/date tool surface; simulation-clock / dated-rule capability. affects_units: scoped to the date/time BP — per-unit refresh + world-drift attention
/bin/discount tool surface; a new verb can enable a discount workflow even without a docs/schema change. affects_units: scoped to the discount BP — per-unit refresh + world-drift attention
/bin/id tool surface; caller identity (guest/customer/employee) capability. affects_units: scoped to the identity/refs BPs — per-unit refresh + world-drift attention
/bin/payments tool surface; new verbs (e.g. refund approval/finalization) signal a new payment-side workflow. affects_units: scoped to the payments BP — per-unit refresh + world-drift attention
/bin/sql tool surface; read-only warehouse query capability and usage contract. Cross-cutting (most BPs query SQL) — left world-only (matcher skips, world_refresh owns) to avoid per-unit fan-out

/bin tool surface (auto-tracked): every `bin-help/*.help.txt` is world-tracked so a new or changed `/bin/<tool>` surfaces in the executor world-drift ATTENTION and triggers world_refresh even when no world.json entry enumerates it. affects_units left implicitly True (absent from world_dep_signatures), so the matcher still flags an owning BP stale and a unit may pin this help as a dependency.
